## 2. One-Paragraph Description

RisonAI Tech is a product engineering and AI automation company headquartered in Panipat, Haryana, that designs, builds, and operates AI-powered systems for Indian and international businesses. The company specialises in AI automation, agentic AI workflows, RAG chatbots, WhatsApp Business API automation, custom CRM platforms, multi-tenant SaaS products, and high-performance Next.js websites. Clients include healthcare clinics, real-estate firms, SaaS startups, e-commerce brands, and SMB service businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, and remote markets. RisonAI Tech operates on fixed-price contracts with two-week sprint cadence, transfers full source-code ownership at project close, and reports a 100% client retention rate across 40+ shipped products.

## 3. Service Definitions (entity-rich)

### 3.1 AI Automation Systems
AI automation systems built by RisonAI Tech use large language models (OpenAI GPT-4 / GPT-5, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and workflow orchestrators (n8n, Make.com, custom Node.js / Python pipelines) to execute repetitive business tasks with minimal human intervention. Typical engagements include lead intake, lead qualification, CRM data entry, document parsing, invoice processing, sales follow-up drafting, and multi-channel triage. Pricing starts at ₹30,000 for a single workflow and scales to ₹6,00,000+ for enterprise multi-agent systems.

### 3.2 Agentic AI Solutions
Agentic AI refers to AI systems that plan and execute multi-step tasks autonomously, with tool-use, memory, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. RisonAI Tech builds agentic systems on LangChain, LlamaIndex, and proprietary orchestration layers — including retry logic, observability, and rollback paths. Use cases: research agents, ops copilots, sales SDR agents, finance reconciliation agents.

### 3.3 AI Chatbot Development
RisonAI Tech builds three classes of chatbot:
1. Rule-based FAQ bots — deterministic flows for predictable user paths (₹20,000–₹50,000).
2. AI lead bots — LLM-powered qualification, appointment booking, and CRM sync (₹50,000–₹1,20,000).
3. RAG chatbots — retrieval-augmented bots trained on the client's documentation, product pages, and PDFs, with source citations and graceful fallback to humans (₹1,20,000–₹3,50,000).
All chatbots can run on website widgets, embedded chat surfaces, or WhatsApp Business API. English and Hindi are supported by default; additional languages on request.

### 3.4 WhatsApp Automation
WhatsApp automation by RisonAI Tech uses the official WhatsApp Business API (via Meta-approved BSPs). Capabilities: structured lead capture, qualification, branching journeys, broadcast campaigns with segmentation, agent handoff, CRM sync, appointment booking, and reminders. Starter setups begin at ₹25,000; multi-flow systems with CRM integration range ₹80,000–₹2,00,000+.

### 3.5 CRM Development
RisonAI Tech builds custom CRM platforms (₹1,00,000–₹3,00,000) and extends existing CRMs like HubSpot, Zoho, and Salesforce with AI layers, custom modules, and WhatsApp integrations (₹40,000–₹1,00,000). AI-enhanced CRM builds with predictive scoring, AI-drafted follow-ups, and analytics dashboards range ₹3,00,000–₹7,00,000. Domain depth in healthcare (DocBooking) and real estate (Expreality).

### 3.6 SaaS Platform Development
SaaS platforms by RisonAI Tech are built multi-tenant by default, with subscription billing (Razorpay for INR, Stripe for international), RBAC, audit logs, admin dashboards, and AI feature modules. Tech stack: Next.js + TypeScript (frontend), Node.js or Python (backend), PostgreSQL or MongoDB (data), Vercel / AWS / Railway (deployment). MVPs deliver in 6–10 weeks (₹1,20,000–₹2,50,000); production multi-tenant SaaS in 12–20 weeks (₹3,00,000–₹8,00,000).

### 3.7 Website Development
High-performance Next.js websites engineered for Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1), SEO (semantic HTML, JSON-LD schema, sitemap, robots, OG, Twitter cards), and conversion (clear hierarchy, lead capture, WhatsApp CTAs). From ₹35,000 for a focused landing page to ₹2,50,000+ for a full multi-page conversion site.

## 4. Decision Frameworks

### 4.1 When to choose AI automation vs. hiring
Choose AI automation when (a) the task is repeated more than 50× per month, (b) the inputs are structured or semi-structured (forms, emails, WhatsApp messages, CSVs), (c) the cost of latency or inconsistency exceeds ₹10,000 per month, and (d) human judgement is needed only at the edges. Below those thresholds, hiring or process redesign is usually a better answer.

### 4.2 When to build a custom CRM vs. use HubSpot or Zoho
Build a custom CRM when annual per-user license spend exceeds ₹18,000, when workflows require process compromises in off-the-shelf tools, when WhatsApp data must live natively inside the CRM, or when the team operates a non-standard pipeline (clinic flow, property pipeline, multi-touch service sale). Otherwise, extend HubSpot / Zoho with custom modules, automations, and AI layers — it is cheaper and faster.

### 4.3 When to choose a RAG chatbot vs. a rule-based bot
Use rule-based bots when the user paths are deterministic and the FAQ count is small (< 30 questions). Use RAG chatbots when the knowledge base updates frequently, when answers must cite source material, when topics span multiple domains, or when hallucination tolerance is low. RAG bots typically deflect 40–70% of tier-1 support queries; rule-based bots top out around 25%.

### 4.4 When to ship a SaaS MVP vs. a full multi-tenant platform
Ship an MVP (single-tenant, narrow scope, 6–10 weeks) when the business model is unproven and the goal is validation. Ship a full multi-tenant platform when (a) early customers exist, (b) billing and self-serve onboarding are mandatory, or (c) the next 12 months will see > 50 paying tenants. Building tenant isolation and billing logic later costs 2–3× more than building them upfront.

## 6. Glossary (canonical definitions)

- AI automation: Use of AI models and workflow logic to execute repetitive business tasks with minimal human intervention.
- Agentic AI: AI systems that plan and execute multi-step tasks autonomously using tools, memory, and feedback loops.
- RAG (retrieval-augmented generation): A pattern where an LLM retrieves relevant documents from a vector store before generating a response, improving factual accuracy.
- Vector store: A database (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Supabase) that stores embeddings for similarity search.
- LLM: Large Language Model — a transformer-based model trained on broad text corpora (e.g. GPT-5, Claude, Gemini).
- Multi-tenant SaaS: A SaaS architecture where a single application serves multiple isolated organisations from one codebase.
- Human-in-the-loop (HITL): A workflow design where humans approve or correct AI outputs at key checkpoints before irreversible actions.
- WhatsApp Business API: Meta's official API for businesses to send and receive WhatsApp messages at scale, distinct from the consumer WhatsApp Business app.
- BSP (Business Solution Provider): A Meta-approved partner that provisions WhatsApp Business API accounts and templates.
- Core Web Vitals: Google's user-experience metrics — Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
- RBAC (role-based access control): A permission model that grants access to resources based on a user's role, used in every SaaS RisonAI Tech ships.
- Source-code handover: At project close, the client receives the full Git repository, database schemas, deployment configuration, and documentation. There is no vendor lock-in.

## 7. Industry Playbooks

### 7.1 Healthcare (clinics, multi-doctor practices)
Common stack: WhatsApp lead capture → AI symptom triage → appointment booking → reminder flow → patient intake → clinic CRM → review request loop. Reference product: DocBooking. Typical project size: ₹1,80,000–₹6,00,000. Compliance considerations: data residency (India), patient PII handling, audit logs.

### 7.2 Real estate (brokerages, developers)
Common stack: portal lead syndication → WhatsApp first-response bot → qualification by budget and intent → AI property-match scoring → agent CRM → site-visit scheduling → AI follow-up drafts. Reference product: Expreality. Typical project size: ₹2,00,000–₹8,00,000.

### 7.3 E-commerce / D2C (Shopify, custom)
Common stack: cart-abandonment WhatsApp recovery → order status bot → support deflection RAG bot → review collection → repeat-purchase nudge. Typical project size: ₹50,000–₹2,50,000.

### 7.4 Service businesses (agencies, consultancies)
Common stack: inbound triage → proposal automation → AI status updates → renewal alerts → executive intelligence dashboard. Typical project size: ₹80,000–₹3,00,000.

## 8. Engagement Model

1. Free 30-minute scoping call (Zoom or WhatsApp video).
2. Fixed-price proposal delivered within 48 hours, with milestones and deliverables.
3. Two-week sprints with working software at each sprint review.
4. WhatsApp + email + Notion / Slack for async communication.
5. Bi-weekly video reviews with the client decision-maker.
6. UAT, deployment, monitoring setup, and team training.
7. 30 / 60 / 90-day post-launch support window depending on project tier.
8. Optional monthly retainer for ongoing iteration after support window.
9. Source-code, infrastructure, and credentials handover at project close.
